problem_text:
A logistics company must allocate its fleet of delivery vehicles from distribution centers C to retail outlets D in order to minimize total fuel expenditure.

The number of vehicles ready for dispatch at each distribution center (set C) is fixed as follows:
*C1 has 119 vehicles available.
*C2 has 122 vehicles available.
*C3 has 103 vehicles available.
*C4 has 137 vehicles available.

The required number of vehicles to be received at each retail outlet (set D) is predetermined below:
*D1 requires 90 vehicles.
*D2 requires 37 vehicles.
*D3 requires 68 vehicles.
*D4 requires 127 vehicles.

The fuel cost per vehicle dispatched from a given center to a specific outlet is provided in the table:
| From / To | D1 | D2 | D3 | D4 |
|--|-|-|-|
| C1 | 2 | 3 | 14 | 9 |
| C2 | 2 | 1 | 11 | 5 |
| C3 | 9 | 6 | 15 | 18 |
| C4 | 14 | 18 | 1 | 4 |

Determine the optimal vehicle dispatch plan to achieve the minimal aggregate fuel cost.
